verdict.rationale: Financial statement reporting is a fair question for accounting software like Moneybird, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only authentication, contacts, invoicing, payments, time tracking, tax submission and developer channels. Nothing documents generating a P&L, balance sheet or cash-flow statement for an arbitrary period.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand
